summary: Iteration 10 e2e + API testing for SpendPulse (mobile+OTP auth, date-wise entry, calculator, calendar, split add/delete, admin delete). Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass (send-otp returns demo_otp, signup/login/wrong-password/duplicate/mismatch/reset all correct, split create+delete cascades to linked transaction, friends add/list, date field persisted, admin access-control 403 for non-admin and admin-delete-user succeeds). Frontend UI smoke: signup flow with demo-otp-banner works and lands on dashboard; add-transaction sheet exposes open-date-picker and open-calculator (calc-display renders); Splits nav works; on /split/new the add-member-btn opens AddMemberSheet with add-member-tab-manual + new-member-name + submit-add-member and manual add works; save-split creates the split and routes to /split/{id}; split-delete opens the in-app confirm modal (confirm-delete-split) and the DELETE /splits/{id} call succeeds (verified via console + backend). All three reported bugs (add split member, delete split, admin delete user) are fixed end-to-end.

integration_issues.issue: After confirm-delete-split, the backend DELETE succeeds but router.back() logs 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' if the user arrived at /split/[id] via router.replace (e.g. right after creating a split). Normal path (splits list -> detail -> delete) works. Consider router.replace('/splits') as a safe fallback in performDelete.

action_items: Optional: in /app/frontend/app/split/[id].tsx performDelete(), replace router.back() with `router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/splits')` to avoid the GO_BACK warning when the detail was reached via router.replace after create.
Console warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' repeatedly. Not blocking, but consider migrating shadow* styles to boxShadow in the split styles module.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses Pydantic v2 field_validator + model_dump correctly; MongoDB _id is excluded on all list/get projections. Good.
Split DELETE endpoint correctly cascades linked transaction (verified).
OTP challenges are hashed and rate-limited (5 attempts) with TTL index. Good.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows pass; only minor GO_BACK UX artifact on delete-just-after-create)

seed_data_creation: Signup created several TEST_* users via API + one UI signup (TEST_UI_User). Admin fixture (9876543210/password123) reused.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iter10.py (pytest). Admin login: 9876543210 / password123. Demo OTP is returned in send-otp response and shown in demo-otp-banner / reset-demo-otp banners. All three original bugs are verified fixed.
rca_of_issue: Original bugs (can't add member, can't delete split, can't delete user) were caused by Alert.alert 2-button confirm callbacks not firing on Expo web. Main agent replaced those with dedicated in-app confirm Modals (confirm-delete-split, confirm-delete-user, confirm-delete-admin-tx) and a manual AddMemberSheet - all now function correctly on web preview.
